name: Cackle
description: Once per round: Roll Spirit vs Spirit against each foe within medium range. On each win, the foe checks a Condition. No effect on a loss.
successes:
✨: On each win, for 1 round, the foe must spend its full movement moving away from you.

🌞: On each win, the foe takes 1 Shadow.

💀: Check a Condition.
